page_title: VLL 0-0 RSO | Valladolid v Real Sociedad 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is yellow-carded.
90+2' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valladolid comes to nothing.
88' Kike Perez (Valladolid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valladolid.
86' Kike Perez (Valladolid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
84' Alex Remiro is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Lucas Rosa (Valladolid). Easy save!
81' That will be all from Takefusa Kubo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
81' Nayef Aguerd goes off the pitch and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) comes on.
78' Here is a change. Abdulay Juma Bah is going off and Paulo Pezzolano gives the last tactical orders to Eray Comert (Valladolid).
78' Substitution. Raul Moro will be replaced by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid).
75' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him and his close-range header went a whisker wide of the right post.
73' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
72' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
70' Raul Moro (Valladolid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
69' The goal by Real Sociedad won’t count as referee Guillermo Cuadra disallows the goal on the advice of the video assistant referee.
67' Real Sociedad score a goal, but referee Guillermo Cuadra has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
66' Real Sociedad win a corner.
66' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
61' It will be a substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is ready to enter the pitch as Orri Oskarsson walks off.
61' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to substitute Darwin Machis and he is replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
61' Substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) has come on for Luka Sucic.
60' One of the players from Real Sociedad times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
58' The referee is firm and issues Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) a deserved yellow card.
55' Luis Perez (Valladolid) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
54' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
53' This is a yellow card! Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
51' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
46' The game is over for Selim Amallah (Valladolid). Kike Perez comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Guillermo Cuadra starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Karl Hein makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) after a cross from the side.
45+1' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

44' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
42' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Karl Hein (Valladolid) leaps to collect the ball.
42' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
40' The ball is behind the touchline and Valladolid will take a throw-in.
38' Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick from long range.
35' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.

33' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
32' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
31' Real Sociedad are ruled offside.
31' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

28' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Real Sociedad force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' The resulting set piece from Valladolid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Raul Moro (Valladolid) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The ball is out of play and Valladolid manage to earn a corner.
27' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
25' The ball is cleared after Raul Moro (Valladolid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
22' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Remiro punches the ball away.
22' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
22' A player from Real Sociedad takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Valladolid.
21' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
19' Valladolid take a short corner kick.
17' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' Cenk Ozkacar is substituted due to injury. Paulo Pezzolano gives a chance to David Torres (Valladolid).
10' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
9' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
9' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

8' Luis Perez (Valladolid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Valladolid will have an opportunity.
7' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Sociedad was in an offside position.
3' Luis Perez (Valladolid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Valladolid will kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will supervise the game today.
